entities.summary: Roger Searle Penske, often referred to by his nickname "the Captain", is an American auto racing team owner, businessman, and former professional driver. He is the owner of Team Penske, the Indianapolis Motor Speedway, IndyCar, and other auto racing-related businesses. Penske is the founder, chairman, and namesake of the Penske Corporation, a holding company for his various businesses. Penske received the Presidential Medal of Freedom from President Donald Trump in 2019.
